player_prompt.intro:
Haere mai ki Frozen Lake!

Ko koe e whakakīa ana i 'P' ki runga i te papa.
Tohu papa:
  ' ' = Rauropi (haumaru ki te haere)
  'H' = Poka (taka atu, ngaro!
  'G' = Whāinga (tū ki konei ki te win!
  'P' = Tō wahi o naianei

Mahi tūtohu: runga, raro, mauī, matau (w, a, s, d)
Tuhia tō mahi hei: [up], [down], [left], [right], [w], [a], [s], [d]

Whāinga: Whakatika atu i te tīmatanga (maui-ki-mauī) ki te whāinga (raro-matau) kia kore e taka ki roto i ngā poka!

invalid_move.wrong_format: He āhua hē ki te whakatinana. Whakamahia [up], [down], [left], [right] rānei [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Mahi kore e mohiotia ana '{action}'. Whakamahia ki runga, raro, maui, matau, w ranei, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: I whāia koe ki te neke i {action} engari kua tu ki te tūpu!

game_action.moved: Kua neke koe i {action} ki te tūranga ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Kia ora, kua eke koe ki te whāinga!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Kua hinga koe ki roto i te poka! Ka mutu te kēmu. I oti {pct}% o te haerenga ki te whāinga.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae koe ki te rohe huri! Ka mutu. I oti i a koe {pct}% o te haerenga ki te whainga.
